description: Links specific evidence items to a DRAFT dossier. Call once per case file containing evidences to link. After linking all evidences, call dossier_certify to finalize. For a single-group dossier, use dossier_group_certify instead (one step). Example: dossier_evidence_link({ caseFileId: '...', dossierId: '...', caseFileToLinkId: '...', ids: ['ev-uuid-1', 'ev-uuid-2'] })

caseFileId.description: UUID of the case file that owns the dossier

caseFileToLinkId.description: UUID of the case file containing the evidences (often same as caseFileId)

dossierId.description: UUID of the DRAFT dossier to link evidences to

ids.description: UUIDs of the evidence items to link

name: dossier_evidence_link
